title: Bar Series Lemonade Ice 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Lemonade Ice by Bar Series captures the familiar sparkle of fizzy Lemonade with a crisp menthol twist. The Lemonade flavour is bright and citrusy, delivering sweet-sour citrus notes with a tangy kick, while a streak of cool Ice rounds off the exhale for a clean, refreshing finish. It's a brisk, citrus vape that's both energising and well-balanced. Formulated with nicotine salts, this e-liquid delivers a smooth, yet tactile throat hit and rapid nicotine uptake. It's blended at a 50VG/50PG ratio, making it ideal for mouth-to-lung (MTL) vaping with pod kits and starter devices. Explore Bar Series' wide range of flavours, which includes fruit blends, confectionery, icy menthols and many more exciting profiles crafted with extra-concentrated flavour for intense taste. Bar Series e-liquids cater to all vapers by offering 5mg, 10mg and 20mg nic salts designed to perform perfectly in your favourite pod kit. Ideal for refillable vape UK and vape starter kit UK devices.
